newsitem.title: UK: BTG profit warning despite positive H1.
newsitem.headline: BTG profit warning despite positive H1.

text.p: British diversified group BTG Plc detailed its return to profitabilty for its first six months to September 30, on Monday but remained cautious on profitability for the whole year.
The company reported a pretax profit of 0.17 million stg on a turnover of 12.1 million stg against last year's loss of 2.1 million for the first six months.
But it said:"... It would be misleading to interpret this performance as indicative of a return to profitability in the current year".
"Short term fluctuations are to be expected in our business which is sensitive to the timing of decisions made and actions taken by our licenses," BTG said in a statement.
The board did not recommend an interim dividend but said, in the absence of unforseen circumstances, it expected to recommend a dividend in respect of the full year to be paid in August 1997.
Company chairman Jack Leonard said BTG had benefitted from sizeable revenue payments linked to specific technologies during the first six months.
It had received an additional revenue of 0.66 million stg from Pyrethrin and MRI compared to the previous year. Revenues from Pyrethrin have now ended, the company said.
The company got 0.84 million stg in October selling 600,000 shares in IOC International.
